title: Understanding the Pattern
text: To extract the course IDs, we need to identify the pattern that follows the word 'Data'. The IDs can be either three digits or $$\frac{one}{two}$$ digits followed by a letter from the set ['c', 's', 'x'].

title: Three-Digit Course IDs
text: The first part of the pattern should match course IDs that consist of exactly three digits. How can you represent three digits in RegEx?

title: Three-Digit Pattern
text: Write the RegEx pattern to match exactly three digits.

title: One or Two Digits with Optional Letter
text: The second part of the pattern should match course IDs that consist of one or two digits, optionally followed by a letter from the set ['c', 's', 'x']. How can you represent this in RegEx?

title: One or Two Digits with Optional Letter Pattern
text: Write the RegEx pattern to match one or two digits, optionally followed by a letter from the set ['c', 's', 'x'].

title: Combining Patterns
text: Combine the patterns for three-digit course IDs and $$\frac{one}{two}$$ digits with an optional letter to form the complete RegEx pattern.

title: Complete RegEx Pattern
text: Combine the patterns to form the complete RegEx pattern for extracting course IDs.
